metadata.title: DNS Zoning and Views

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for defining intentional DNS resolution boundaries using zones and views to preserve trust, limit exposure, and constrain blast radius.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: DNS zones, views, split-horizon configurations, delegation boundaries, and namespace isolation.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Defines DNS zoning and view behavior as a trust boundary control rather than a naming convenience.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for guidance on DNS delegation, zone boundaries, and operational considerations that impact trust and failure behavior, as described in Section 4.1 (Signing Zones) and Section 6 (Operational Considerations). This guidance informs delegation risk and boundary design, not DNSSEC mechanics.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Referenced for cyber resiliency guidance related to Withstand objectives and segmentation techniques, emphasizing containment and blast-radius limitation through explicit boundaries, as described in Section 3.2 and Section 4.2.

metadata.remarks: DNS Zoning and Views defines how DNS namespaces are segmented and selectively exposed to constrain trust domains, prevent unintended resolution, and limit the impact of misconfiguration or compromise. This pattern treats zones and views as security boundaries, not merely administrative constructs.

components.title: DNS Zone Boundary Definition
components.description: Defines explicit DNS zone boundaries to limit authority and resolution scope.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exploitation of overly broad DNS authority or misconfigured delegation to extend attacker influence.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit definition of trust boundaries to constrain the scope of DNS authority.

implemented-requirements.remarks: DNS authority and resolution boundaries are explicitly defined to limit exposure and unintended access.

components.title: DNS View Isolation
components.description: Defines how different DNS responses are presented based on request context to preserve trust boundaries.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Enumeration of internal resources through improperly isolated DNS views.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Segmentation of DNS responses to limit information disclosure across contexts.

implemented-requirements.remarks: DNS views restrict information flow between trust contexts to prevent unintended disclosure.

components.title: DNS Delegation Governance
components.description: Governs creation, modification, and removal of DNS delegations to preserve trust boundaries.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Compromise of delegated infrastructure to propagate malicious resolution behavior.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Restriction and governance of DNS delegation actions to limit blast radius.

implemented-requirements.remarks: DNS delegation changes are governed and controlled to prevent unauthorized expansion of trust.
